title: Answer: no feeling emerges, a model evolved

statements.text: AST denies that a feeling emerges from brain processes. What arose, over evolution, is a model of attention that higher cognition reads, and that model is the source of the belief that something emerges.

sources.quote: Illusionism explains the behavior of the system without postulating the existence of a consciousness stuff that emerges from or resides in any part of the system.
